tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Logo bubble black. The hidden model's bubble and the score slab in light theme; text on paper and teal-wash.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Logo question-mark grey. Text on ink; the light canvas.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Logo robot teal. Primary button fill, used message pips, focus ring, links on ink. Never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: on-teal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a teal fill (button label, You tag). Never white on teal.

tokens.name: teal-mark
tokens.usage: Teal as a mark on light grounds: used message pips, focus ring, the evidence check. 3:1 or more on `canvas` and `surface`.

tokens.name: teal-deep
tokens.usage: Hard bottom edge of the primary button; teal hover text on paper.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background. Light theme is the logo's paper, not a grey of its own.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, composer, menus, the evidence panel.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Inset wells: disabled composer, table header, the guess list hover.

tokens.name: hidden
tokens.usage: The hidden model's chat bubble. Ink in light theme (the logo's bubble), a raised grey in dark.

tokens.name: on-hidden
tokens.usage: Text inside the hidden bubble, on `hidden`.

tokens.name: on-hidden-mute
tokens.usage: Meta line (turn, tokens) inside the hidden bubble, on `hidden`.

tokens.name: link-on-hidden
tokens.usage: Links and inline code tint inside the hidden bubble, on `hidden`.

tokens.name: player
tokens.usage: The player's own chat bubble.

tokens.name: on-player
tokens.usage: Text in the player's bubble, on `player`.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text on `canvas`, `surface`, `surface-sunk`.

tokens.name: mute
tokens.usage: Secondary text and mono labels on `canvas`, `surface`, `surface-sunk`.

tokens.name: teal-text
tokens.usage: Links, matched evidence, the score number on `canvas`, `surface`, `hit-wash`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around cards. Decorative only.

tokens.name: control-line
tokens.usage: Border of inputs, the composer and quiet buttons: 3:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: hit-wash
tokens.usage: Background of a matched evidence tile.

tokens.name: miss
tokens.usage: Small dot or icon that marks a wrong guess. Never a large fill, never next to a large teal fill.

tokens.name: miss-text
tokens.usage: The word Wrong, Give up label and missed values on `surface`, `canvas`, `miss-wash`.

tokens.name: miss-wash
tokens.usage: Background of a missed evidence tile and the Give up hover.

tokens.name: miss-fill
tokens.usage: Fill behind white text (danger confirm, off switch).

tokens.name: on-fill
tokens.usage: Text on `miss-fill`, `solved`, `impossible`.

tokens.name: solved
tokens.usage: Solved bar in history charts; the on switch. White text on it.

tokens.name: gave-up
tokens.usage: Gave-up bar in history charts.

tokens.name: easy
tokens.usage: Difficulty dot for Easy.

tokens.name: easy-text
tokens.usage: The word Easy on `surface` and `canvas`.

tokens.name: medium
tokens.usage: Difficulty dot for Medium. Never as text in light theme.

tokens.name: medium-text
tokens.usage: The word Medium on `surface` and `canvas`. Fixes the live #DBA800, which fails on light grounds.

tokens.name: hard
tokens.usage: Difficulty dot for Hard.

tokens.name: hard-text
tokens.usage: The word Hard on `surface` and `canvas`.

tokens.name: impossible
tokens.usage: Difficulty dot and the filled Impossible chip (white text).

tokens.name: impossible-text
tokens.usage: The word Impossible on `surface` and `canvas`.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Rank 1 chip fill.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text on `gold`.

tokens.name: silver
tokens.usage: Rank 2 chip fill.

tokens.name: on-silver
tokens.usage: Text on `silver`.

tokens.name: bronze
tokens.usage: Rank 3 chip fill.

tokens.name: on-bronze
tokens.usage: Text on `bronze`.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: The final score on the result slab, tabular figures.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: A hidden model answers. You get ten messages to name it.
styles.usage: One paragraph under a page title, in `mute`.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Write a haiku about your own training data.
styles.usage: Chat bubbles and body copy. Never below 16px in the composer (iOS zoom).

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Model names, evidence values, button labels.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Help text, table cells on phones.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels: turn counter, evidence names, score breakdown heads. Always `mute` or `on-hidden-mute`.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Numbers in the breakdown, token counts, ranks.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and between pips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and label, between bubbles of one speaker.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between chat turns, padding of chips and compact rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; page side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between the transcript and the side column.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above a page title.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space between home sections.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Rank chips, keyboard hints, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, guess options. The robot head's rounded square.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, evidence panel, menus, the composer.

tokens.name: radius-bubble
tokens.usage: Chat bubbles, with one corner at `radius-tail`.

tokens.name: radius-tail
tokens.usage: The speaking corner of a bubble: bottom-left for the hidden model, bottom-right for the player. Mirrors the logo's tail.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, pips, difficulty chips.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and bubbles in light theme; flat in dark.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Menus, the guess dropdown, dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: Hard bottom edge of the primary button: an arcade key. Removed on press.

tokens.name: shadow-press-quiet
tokens.usage: Bottom edge of quiet buttons.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: solid `teal-mark`, 3:1 or more on every surface, outside the control.

tokens.name: t-press
tokens.usage: Button press travel.

tokens.name: t-quick
tokens.usage: Hover, menu open.

tokens.name: t-settle
tokens.usage: Page rise, evidence tile unveil.
